_comment: IR-20 admits ONE named command at ONE file per entry, and nothing else. An entry is a reviewed decision with its IR, not a convenience: a command NAME is resolved by the host, so every entry is a place the hosts may disagree. tools/checks/spawn-resolve.mjs reads this file.

exceptions.reason: The .py half of the IR-20 sweep is Python's own parser (tools/checks/spawn-portability.py). python3 is already a host dependency of the declared rederive_all command, so this adds no host the gate does not already need.
